used.how: the compressed-layer attention keeps the window step's sparse_sdpa dtypes (high_precision + fp32_scores + bf16_probs, bf16 q / output, 512^-0.5 folded into q): TtSparseAttention subclasses TtWindowAttention (tt/sparse_attention.py)
sink passed as sink / 1 with the op scale 1.0 (the softmax scale folded into q), reused from tt/attention.py
top-k ids mapped to table rows in fp32 and sent back as fp32 -> int32 -> bitcast uint32 so -1 stays the 0xFFFFFFFF sentinel (tt/sparse_attention.py:_topk_rows)
the window region (carry from the served cache + chunk, cache write) comes from TtWindowAttention._table / TtWindowCache unchanged
the served compressed cache is in token units: the local slice [nb stripe, 256] is viewed as [nb stripe / 2, 512] compressed rows before the mesh gather; group j -> owner (2j / stripe) mod N

q's RoPE stays the exact fp32 SFPU rope_heads, with interleave=True so q matches the stored (interleaved) compressed rows; output de-interleaved (new tt/rope.deinterleave_tail) before the inverse RoPE
added attention to hooks DEVICE_STEPS['enc_source'] so the hybrid / contract test runs it
explained the 'small' second-input miss: bf16 rounding of the attention output o flips 3.1 % of the fp8 values after it (rel 0.0329 on the CPU alone)

attributed the device's extra coherent shrink of o in the flat-softmax 'small' regime (-8.9e-4 vs the kernel model's -2.2e-4) to the FPU's in-tile partial-dot truncation in P@V; not fixable at normal settings (no split matmul)

contradicted.evidence: Fix says ttnn.bringup.sparse_sdpa(high_precision=True) has 'no sink' (and the components entry says it refuses attention_sink at sparse_sdpa_device_operation.cpp:132): out of date. The sdpa fork's INDEX.md row and CHANGELOG list 'sparse_sdpa high_precision with attention_sink'; sparse_sdpa_device_operation.cpp:126-133 only checks fp32 DEST and the q / kv dtypes; tt/attention.py:_sdpa and tt/sparse_attention.py call it with attention_sink and high_precision=True (C.swa.attention and this gate's golden check pass).

missing: sparse_sdpa stops at the first 0xFFFFFFFF of an index row (sentinels must be a contiguous tail, sparse_sdpa_reader.cpp:9); a [window | top-k] list needs compaction for rows whose window is short (only in TtCSA.index_tables' docstring)

the component checks' second inputs (small, big, ...) get no official-arithmetic floor: a step whose official kernel rounds an internal value (DeepSeek sparse_attn's bf16 output before the fp8 q-dq) can miss the fixed 0.03 second-input floor at the reference's own precision (DS41-51)
